title: Rational design, synthesis and biological evaluation of benzo[d]isoxazole derivatives as potent BET bivalent inhibitors for potential treatment of prostate cancer.
authors: Li, Junhua; Zhu, Run; Zhuang, Xiaoxi; Zhang, Cheng; Shen, Hui; Wu, Xishan; Zhang, Maofeng; Huang, Cen; Xiang, Qiuping; Zhao, Linxiang; Xu, Yong; Zhang, Yan
one_liner_zh: 该文设计BET溴结构域双价抑制剂并用于前列腺癌治疗，虽涉及蛋白-配体结合与对接，但对象为蛋白-小分子而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无TF-DNA结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Multivalency is an attractive strategy for effective binding to target protein. Bromodomain and extra-terminal (BET) family features two tandem bromodomains (BD1, BD2), which are considered to be potential new targets for prostate cancer. Herein, we report the rational design, optimization, and evaluation of a class of novel BET bivalent inhibitors based on our monovalent BET inhibitor 7 (Y06037). The representative bivalent inhibitor 17b effectively inhibited the cell growth of LNCaP, exhibiting 32 folds more potency than monovalent inhibitor 7. Besides, 17b induced 95.1 % PSA regression in LNCaP cell at 2 muM. Docking study was further carried out to reveal the potential binding mode of 17b with two BET bromodomains. Our study demonstrates that 17b (Y13021) is a promising BET bivalent inhibitor for the treatment of prostate cancer.
abstract_zh: 多价性是实现靶蛋白有效结合的一种有吸引力的策略。溴结构域和末端外（BET）家族具有两个串联的溴结构域（BD1、BD2），被认为是前列腺癌的潜在新靶点。在此，我们报告了一类基于单价BET抑制剂7（Y06037）的新型BET双价抑制剂的合理设计、优化和评估。代表性双价抑制剂17b有效抑制了LNCaP细胞的生长，其效力比单价抑制剂7高出32倍。此外，在2 μM浓度下，17b诱导LNCaP细胞中95.1%的PSA回归。进一步进行了对接研究，以揭示17b与两个BET溴结构域的可能结合模式。我们的研究表明，17b（Y13021）是一种有前景的BET双价抑制剂，可用于前列腺癌的治疗。
